## Is the air quality good in Kuala Lumpur?

As of October 8, 2026, at 8:00 PM (local time), air quality in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia is very unhealthy, with an AQI of 203, driven by traffic emissions, regional haze, and weather conditions. [...] Kuala Lumpur’s poor air quality is being worsened by smoke from fires in Sumatra and Kalimantan, Indonesia. Moderate to dense smoke haze is affecting parts of Peninsular Malaysia, with prevailing winds allowing pollution from these fires to spread across national borders (1).
